Release notes

This release adds three features and fixes a nasty bug. Whitespace is collapsed.

Highlights

  • Faster parse()
  • New nodes
    1. XML
    2. HTML
  • Old API removed

Example

func main() {
	fmt.Println("*not emphasis*")
}

Quoted text.

Second line of the quote.

Stars * and _underscores_ and [brackets] are escaped.
After a break.

# not a heading
